_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Bo ta joga Golf (Jogu di Kartu) - Jogadör {player_id}.
Meta: Bo ten ki pontu total máis baixo na rodada singela. Si kolónna komparti mesmu balor, eli somadu komu 0.
Balor di Kartu: A=1, 2-10=balor di fas, J/Q=10, K=0

Akseyon (usa braketadu eksatu):
- '[draw]' - Tira di baraha
- '[take]' - Tira di monti di desisti
- '[swap X Y]' - Troka kartu di drew ku pozison X (linha) Y (kolónna)
- '[discard]' - Desisti di kartu di drew

board.drew:
Bu tiru: {card}
Agora bu é obrigadu [swap X Y] ou [discard] el.
board.took:
Bo tira: {card} di monti di desisti
Bo ten ki [swap X Y] ku el (no pódé desisti)

options.final_turns: Turnu final! Bo opsió: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Bu debe: [swap X Y] (ka pode skese di kartas ki sta na pila)
options.swap_or_discard: Bo ten ki: [swap X Y] o [discard]

hand.header: Kol: 1 2 3 N ta atxa ma el é más midjór.

message.deck_empty: Baralhu sta vaziu! Jogo ta kaba li d'imediatu.
message.knocked: Jogadör {pid} knock! Kada jogadör outru ten un turnu máis
message.final_round: Jogadör {pid} {reason}! Kada jogadör outru ten un turnu máis

invalid.wrong_action: Usa akseyon ku braketadu: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], o [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Kel monti di kuza ki bu ka ta uza sta tudu skravu!
invalid.must_draw_first: Bo ten ki priméu [draw], [take], [knock], o [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Bu ka pode skese di un karta ki bu toma na monti, má el ten ki ser troka.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Bo ten kartu di drew. Bo ten ki [swap X Y] o [discard]
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Bu meste un karta di sorteu pa bo pode troca.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Bu meste di un karta ki bu traze pa bo ka odja-l.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Pozison fora di limiti. Usa linha 1-{max_row}, kolónna 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Bu ka pode fra ku un karta ki bu tra. Kumpradu primeru kel turno li.
invalid.already_knocked: Un algen dja faze kel ronda li.
invalid.already_revealed: Kel karta dja sta na papel!
